description:
Location: Remote, 1-2 visits initially to the client location (travel - TBA)
 Duration: Projects based, 3 months initially and extended to 12 months
 Skills: 

 5 years experience in Cerner application 
 5 years experience in Cerner report writing
 5 years experience in SQL scripting
 5 years experience in SQL Server 
 5 years of experience in DTS packages a/or SSIS
 Experience and good understanding of reading Cerner data model
 Will be interacting with the client - need to have good positive attitude and great communication skills
 USC or GC preferred 
 If they have 3 years of exp...that is ok as long as they understand Cerner data model and can extract data out of the system and place it into another system (database) by writing data extraction scripts (via DTS or SSIS packages). One of the most important things would be good communication and presentation. 


 
 Good comm skills are a big priority 
 Duration: 3 months initially and extended to 12 months
